_comment: Affiliate + product config for the CW weekly newsletter. These are PUBLIC links shown in the email body, not secrets, so they live here (committed) rather than .env — that also lets the automated GitHub Actions send read them with no secret wiring. generate_newsletter.py rotates the ACTIVE affiliates by ISO week and appends UTMs at render time (base URLs here stay clean). Both ButcherBox and LMNT are live coded links that credit Brew; LMNT's is his refr.cc referral link (same one used across the site). To add another affiliate, append an object with active:true and a real coded URL.

affiliates.name: ButcherBox
affiliates.blurb: On a meat-based diet, sourcing good meat is honestly half the battle. Quality matters, and so does not having to think about it every week. A lot of people use ButcherBox to get grass-fed beef and quality cuts delivered to the door, which takes one real chore off the list.

affiliates.name: LMNT
affiliates.blurb: Those first few weeks of carnivore or keto can hit hard. The headaches, the tired legs, the random muscle cramps. A lot of that comes down to electrolytes running low as your body shifts. A lot of people reach for LMNT to top up sodium, potassium, and magnesium, whether they're adapting or just staying active.

product_feature.blurb: New in our Etsy shop: the Keto Starter Kit, $21.99 CAD. You get a 30-day meal plan, a keto food list, a grocery list, and a simple tracker. It leans keto, and plenty of you eat keto or low-carb, or are easing into stricter meals, so it fits right in. If you like a plan laid out for you, it's worth a look.
